pub type Raw
pub enum Network
  Any
  Unmetered
  pub const ALL: [Self; 2]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub const DOWNSTREAM_RECOVERY_GUARANTEES: [&str; 1]
pub const CREDENTIAL_GUARANTEES: [&str; 1]
pub const NETWORK_COST_GUARANTEES: [&str; 1]
pub const WAITING_EXTENSIONS: [&str; 1]
pub struct Constraints
  network: Option<Network>
pub struct Artifact
  digest: String
  size: i64
pub struct Source
  scheme: String
  locator: String
  credential: String
pub struct Request
  artifact: Artifact
  sources: Vec<Source>
  constraints: Option<Constraints>
pub fn encode(v: &Request) -> Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Request, Refusal>
pub fn encode_constraints_document(v: &Constraints) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Refusal>
pub fn decode_constraints_document(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Constraints, Refusal>
pub fn encode_artifact_document(v: &Artifact) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Refusal>
pub fn decode_artifact_document(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Artifact, Refusal>
pub fn encode_source_document(v: &Source) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Refusal>
pub fn decode_source_document(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Source, Refusal>
pub fn encode_request_document(v: &Request) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Refusal>
pub fn decode_request_document(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Request, Refusal>
pub mod internal
  pub fn decode_constraints_at(data: &[u8], depth: i32, limit: i32) -> Result<(super::Constraints, usize), super::Refusal>
  pub fn check_constraints(v: &super::Constraints, depth: i32, limit: i32) -> Result<(), super::Refusal>
  pub fn encode_constraints_at(v: &super::Constraints, depth: i32) -> Result<Vec<u8>, super::Refusal>
  pub fn decode_artifact_at(data: &[u8], depth: i32, limit: i32) -> Result<(super::Artifact, usize), super::Refusal>
  pub fn check_artifact(v: &super::Artifact, depth: i32, limit: i32) -> Result<(), super::Refusal>
  pub fn encode_artifact_at(v: &super::Artifact, depth: i32) -> Result<Vec<u8>, super::Refusal>
  pub fn decode_source_at(data: &[u8], depth: i32, limit: i32) -> Result<(super::Source, usize), super::Refusal>
  pub fn check_source(v: &super::Source, depth: i32, limit: i32) -> Result<(), super::Refusal>
  pub fn encode_source_at(v: &super::Source, depth: i32) -> Result<Vec<u8>, super::Refusal>
  pub fn decode_request_at(data: &[u8], depth: i32, limit: i32) -> Result<(super::Request, usize), super::Refusal>
  pub fn check_request(v: &super::Request, depth: i32, limit: i32) -> Result<(), super::Refusal>
  pub fn encode_request_at(v: &super::Request, depth: i32) -> Result<Vec<u8>, super::Refusal>
